opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: Cara's rescue mission for academics in immediate danger of imprisonment, injury or death. Works with a Network of 135 universities and research institutes to find temporary refuge (postdoctoral or PhD placements, mostly in the UK) where academics can continue their work until they can return home. Applications are considered on a rolling basis.
